استخلبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَخْلَبُوا (istaḵlabū) /is.tax.la.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
# اُسْتُخْلِبُوا (ustuḵlibū) /us.tux.li.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
# اِسْتَخْلِبُوا (istaḵlibū) /is.tax.li.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
